blurb: Dancing Dreams offers dance classes and performance opportunities for children with medical or physical challenges. It also provides a Teen Leadership Program to help teenagers develop leadership skills. The organization aims to build confidence and self-esteem through dance and increase awareness and tolerance for those with physical challenges.
